additional_info.subject: ID0472635-DC/Si-D/TR-(Y2/S2 300000004037) Low Power Charging Issue CRM:00263000369
additional_info.body:
Hello
Şahin, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
I checked the session you provided and the values are working as expected.
As you can see, there are 2 EVs charging at the same time for a total maximum of 155kW. This is corresponding to the fact that the charger's input power is 165kVa, which, after some deductions from internal components, corresponds to 155kW max power from the charger to give to both outlets.
The charger then makes the logic depending on the available power and divides it for both EVs.
From our side, everything is declared as ok and working as intended.
Please let me know if you understood my explanation and if I can close the ticket.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0472635-DC/Si-D/TR-(Y2/S2 300000004037) Low Power Charging Issue CRM:00263000369
additional_info.body:
Hello Francisco,
Thank you for your explanation and for reviewing the session.
I understand the overall power-sharing logic of the charger and the limitation based on the 165 kVA input power, resulting in a maximum of 155 kW available to be delivered to both outlets.
However, I would like to clarify one important point based on the charger logs. According to the logs, the instantaneous power delivered to the EVs does not reach a total of 155 kW at the same time.
Specifically:
DC1 (EVSE_NowPwr): ~63 kW
DC2 (EVSE_NowPwr): ~56.2 kW
This results in a total instantaneous output power of approximately 119 kW, which is clearly below the stated 155 kW maximum. These values are directly taken from the logs and can be used as objective evidence of the actual power delivered to the vehicles at that moment.
For this reason, I wanted to highlight that while the system may be
capable
of delivering up to 155 kW in total, the actual power delivered during this session was lower, as shown in the logs.
Please let me know your thoughts on this clarification. Once aligned on this point, we can proceed accordingly.
Best regards,
Şahin
